extraction_notes: Main-text measured NH3 synthesis performance figures found: Figure 4a (rate vs temperature) and Figure 4c (thermal stability; only first and last plotted points extracted as instructed). Figure 4b is an Arrhenius plot and was skipped. Other main-text figures are characterisation, DFT/schematics, or tables rather than plotted measured synthesis performance. Values are approximate digitisation from the page image; conditions not on axes were taken from the Figure 4 caption and Experimental section.
